mission: F2 plus F3 mission, delivery (a) of three (owner decision t244u 2026-11-11 23:15 MYT; CP security answer 2026-11-13 23:48 MYT). API tolerant step: one shared collector-token verifier (services/api/app/core/collector_token.py) used by require_current_user and the /me rate-limit key, requiring exp, iat and sub, HS256 only, 30 s leeway, a 10 minute lifetime cap and refusing a future iat; iss card-pirate-web and aud card-pirate-api checked only when present (delivery (b) adds them on the website, delivery (c) requires them). F3: startup warnings (no value, no length) for a weak or placeholder API_JWT_SECRET and a placeholder ADMIN_TOKEN, warn-only outside production so staging stays up; boot refusal comes in delivery (c). Does not protect against a leaked secret.

impacts.reason: Collector bearer tokens are verified in one place. Website tokens today carry sub, iat and exp (apps/web/src/lib/collectorApi.ts mintApiToken 300 s, mintProbeToken 60 s), so every token a real user or the delivery probe sends is still accepted; tokens with no exp or iat, a lifetime over 600 s, a future iat, a wrong iss or aud, or another algorithm are refused. Env validation adds two warn-only checks outside production. Security-relevant enforcement of the owner's t244u decision, no policy change beyond it.
Test tokens now carry iat and exp like the website's; new regression tests for every refusal, the rate-limit path refusing what auth refuses, and the F3 warnings carrying neither value nor length.

routes: Every route behind require_current_user or require_current_user_optional; the /me rate-limit key
impact.deployment_impact: The API rebuilds through its GitHub watch because services/api changed. No collector runtime input changed (changed_runtime_inputs for snkrdunk and yuyutei against component 16e41d4c: import-graph, none of these files). No schema change, no website change.

recovery.procedure: Native revert PR of this merge with its own docs/agent/missions/<name>.json; the API returns to decoding with signature and optional exp only.
recovery.trigger: Collector sign-in or /me requests return 401 for real website tokens, or the delivery's collector_token_check fails after merge.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change.

verification.observation_window: This merge's staging delivery verify, including collector_token_check (the website-signed probe accepted by the API).
